text:
Ana Morales: Quick pass on tri-mode landing copy — posted first draft in Figma. Looking for tight hero + 2 CTAs for hosted/dedicated/private.

Mike Chen: Thanks. Quick thought — make Hosted hero lighter (time-to-value), Dedicated focused on predictability + SLA, Private on security & compliance. Keep same sentence rhythm across modes.

Tara Patel: Agreed. Two hero variants for testing:

```
Hosted: 'Get production-ready inference in minutes — flexible API, pay-as-you-go.'
Dedicated: 'Reserved GPU capacity for predictable throughput and SLAs.'
Private: 'Deploy inference in your VPC or on-prem for full data control.'
```

Tara Patel: For CTA: Primary: 'Get started free' (hosted), 'Request reserved capacity' (dedicated), 'Talk to sales' (private). Secondary universal: 'See benchmarks'.

Ben Ortiz: On inbound routing — let's map CTAs to separate lead flows so MQLs from Private hit AE queue immediately. Proposed UTM/meta: ?src=lp&utm_campaign=tri_mode&utm_variant=hosted|dedicated|private

webhook-bot: New doc created: /drive/Marketing/Pages/tri-mode-landing/tri_mode_v1.fig (Ana Morales)

Sam Li: Webinar tie-in — can we surface a small banner: 'Join our benchmarking webinar — live demo & cost-playbook' with date + register CTA. Route registrants into event cadence -> webinar nurture.

Ana Morales: Love that. For hero copy length, aim 10-12 words max. Also need a short subhead that mentions latency and cost controls for devs.

Mike Chen: One-liners for subheads:
- Hosted: 'Low friction API, predictable pricing, generous free tier.'
- Dedicated: 'Committed capacity, autoscaling, latency SLOs.'
- Private: 'VPC controls, KMS/HSM support, audit logs.'

Tara Patel: I'll mock the A/B test variants in Figma by EOD and add content notes for comms + webinar banner. Can someone add sample tracking params for demo/register buttons?

Ben Ortiz: I'll add the routing spreadsheet and sample UTM strings. Tagging @Sam Li for webinar schedule.

Sam Li: On it — can confirm webinar date (two weeks out) and draft email flow. Also recommend a benchmark snapshot in the landing 'See benchmarks' modal — quick stats (latency, cost comparisons).

Ana Morales: Perfect. Small next steps: Tara to upload A/B variants; Ben to add routing; Sam to confirm webinar date; Mike to approve hero language. Ping me when all done and I'll consolidate.

Ben Ortiz: FYI — suggested lead tags: 'lp_hosted', 'lp_dedicated', 'lp_private', 'webinar_reg'.

Mike Chen: Approve proceeding with above. :thumbsup:

Ana Morales: Thanks team — will schedule a quick sync tomorrow 10am PT if anyone wants to hop on. :calendar:
